description: Ask BRYDGE whether you may take an action, before you take it. ALLOWED returns an authorization id: carry the action out and write that id into the record it creates, where the destination keeps it (for a Stripe refund: metadata.brydge_authorization). ESCALATED means a person decides: do not carry it out, and once they have answered, ask again with the same idempotency_key and details to get their answer.

action.description: The kind of work, as it is set up in BRYDGE, such as refund.

facts.description: What BRYDGE's rules judge the action by, such as {"amount": 4200}. BRYDGE compares a fact named amount with the amount in the destination's record, so give it in the same units.

idempotency_key.description: A name for this one intended action, such as refund:ch_123. Send the same value whenever you ask about the same action again, on a retry or once a person has answered; never reuse it for a different one.

target.description: What the work acts on: the charge, order or ticket id.

name: brydge_supervise
title: Ask BRYDGE before acting
